instruction: In docker-compose.yml, give the agentsmemory service a healthcheck whose test is ["CMD", "agentsmemory", "version"], with interval 30s and retries 3. Put the healthcheck block right after the service's restart line. Change nothing else.

require.match:
(?m)^    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: \["CMD", "agentsmemory", "version"\]
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3
